name: Top Tier VC Starter Template
description: 12 top-tier VC firms with 41 decision-maker contacts. Import this as a starting point and customize for your fundraising journey.

firms.name: Andreessen Horowitz
firms.thesis: We back bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We invest across all stages from seed to growth, with deep expertise in software, bio, crypto, and AI. Our network of 100+ operating partners provides hands-on support.

decisionMakers.name: Marc Andreessen
decisionMakers.title: Co-Founder & General Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Co-authored Mosaic, co-founded Netscape and Opsware. Board member at Meta.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Thinks in frameworks, responds to bold visions. Prefers concise memos over long decks.

decisionMakers.name: Ben Horowitz
decisionMakers.title: Co-Founder & General Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Co-founded Loudcloud/Opsware (acquired by HP for $1.6B). Author of The Hard Thing About Hard Things.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Values operational excellence. Respects founders who have done their homework on GTM.

decisionMakers.name: Katherine Boyle
decisionMakers.title: General Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Leads American Dynamism practice, focusing on companies supporting national interest.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Passionate about defense tech and industrials. Very responsive to founders with technical depth.

decisionMakers.name: Martin Casado
decisionMakers.title: General Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Founded Nicira (acquired by VMware for $1.26B). Pioneer of SDN.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Deep technical evaluator. Loves to dive into architecture. Meetings tend to be 90+ min technical deep-dives.

decisionMakers.name: Jennifer Li
decisionMakers.title: Partner, Growth
decisionMakers.bio: Leads growth-stage investments. Former product lead at Facebook.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Metrics-driven. Always asks about CAC payback and net revenue retention within first 5 minutes.

firms.name: Sequoia Capital
firms.thesis: We partner with the daring from idea to IPO and beyond. We invest early and stay committed for decades. The builders behind Apple, Google, Cisco, WhatsApp, Zoom, and Snowflake chose Sequoia.

decisionMakers.name: Roelof Botha
decisionMakers.title: Senior Steward & Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Former CFO of PayPal. Led investments in YouTube, Instagram, Square, MongoDB.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Extremely analytical. Prefers detailed financial models. Respects founders with accounting discipline.

decisionMakers.name: Alfred Lin
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Former COO/CFO at Zappos. Led investments in Airbnb, DoorDash, Houzz.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Pattern matcher. Known for rapid yes/no decisions. Values customer obsession metrics.

decisionMakers.name: Pat Grady
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Leads AI/data infrastructure investments. Led Snowflake, ZoomInfo, and Klaviyo.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Data infrastructure expert. Always asks about TAM expansion potential and data moats.

decisionMakers.name: Jess Lee
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Co-founder of Polyvore (acquired by Yahoo). Focus on consumer and AI applications.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Product visionary. Deeply cares about UX and design. Best approached with product demos, not decks.

decisionMakers.name: Sonya Huang
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Leads AI practice. Former PM at Google AI. Author of Generative AI market map.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: The go-to AI expert at Sequoia. Stays on bleeding edge. Respects technical teams with research backgrounds.

firms.name: Benchmark
firms.thesis: We take a concentrated, partner-led approach. Each partner makes only 1-2 new investments per year, giving founders our undivided attention. We believe in the power of small.

decisionMakers.name: Peter Fenton
decisionMakers.title: General Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Led investments in Twitter, Yelp, Snapchat, New Relic. Board member at Twitter.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Extremely founder-friendly. Known for rapid conviction. Makes decisions in first meeting.

decisionMakers.name: Sarah Tavel
decisionMakers.title: General Partner
decisionMakers.bio: First PM at Pinterest. Led investments in Chainalysis, Hipcamp, Zagat.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Product thinker. Great at identifying network effects. Prefers to see product before pitch.

decisionMakers.name: Eric Vishria
decisionMakers.title: General Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Co-founder of Polychain (acquired by Yahoo). Focus on AI and enterprise.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Technical background. Likes to whiteboard architecture. Fast decision-maker.

decisionMakers.name: Miles Grimshaw
decisionMakers.title: General Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Led Thrive Capital's expansion. Led investments in Airtable, GitLab, Segment.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Newer to Benchmark, brings growth-stage expertise. Very responsive to warm intros.

firms.name: Accel
firms.thesis: We partner with exceptional founders from inception through all stages of growth. With offices in Palo Alto and London, we have a global perspective on category-defining companies.

decisionMakers.name: Arun Mathew
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Leads enterprise and security investments. Led CrowdStrike, Snyk, and 1Password.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Security expert. Very methodical in evaluation. Loves to see security architecture diagrams.

decisionMakers.name: Ping Li
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Leads data and AI investments. Led Cloudera, Qlik, and Segment.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Data stack expert. Always tracking the modern data stack evolution. Great network in data community.

decisionMakers.name: Andrei Brasoveanu
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: London-based. Leads European investments. Focus on fintech and SaaS.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: European market expert. Great for EU expansion strategy discussions. Very well-connected in London.

firms.name: Greylock Partners
firms.thesis: We invest in early-stage enterprise and consumer companies. We believe in building lasting relationships with founders, often investing before there is a product or even a company.

decisionMakers.name: Reid Hoffman
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Co-founder LinkedIn, partner at Greylock. Board member at Microsoft. Author of Blitzscaling.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Network thinker. Values blitzscaling potential. Introduced through mutual connections works best.

decisionMakers.name: Sarah Guo
decisionMakers.title: Founder, Conviction
decisionMakers.bio: Former Greylock partner, now running her own fund Conviction. Expert in enterprise/AI.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: AI-native investor. Incredibly sharp on product-market fit questions.

decisionMakers.name: Jerry Chen
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Former VP Product at NVIDIA. Leads infrastructure and AI investments.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Infrastructure visionary. Great at spotting platform shifts. Loves technical founders.

firms.name: Lightspeed Venture Partners
firms.thesis: We back exceptional founders and transformative companies from seed to scale. With a global footprint across consumer, enterprise, health, and deep tech, we invest early and stay for the long haul.

decisionMakers.name: Ravi Mhatre
decisionMakers.title: Founding Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Founding partner. Led investments in Nutanix, AppDynamics, MuleSoft.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Deep enterprise DNA. Very experienced board member. Prefers businesses with clear enterprise GTM.

decisionMakers.name: Guru Chahal
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Led investments in Rubrik, Guardicore, and five AI unicorns.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Security and infrastructure focused. Very technical. Loves to do reference calls with customers.

decisionMakers.name: Nicole Quinn
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Leads consumer and brand investments. Led investments in Snap.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Consumer brand expert. Best for B2C pitches. Very visual, loves great product design.

firms.name: Founders Fund
firms.thesis: We invest in companies building the future that others think is impossible. We back science fiction becoming science fact: AI, space, biotech, defense, and next-generation computing.

decisionMakers.name: Peter Thiel
decisionMakers.title: President
decisionMakers.bio: Co-founder PayPal, Palantir, first outside investor in Facebook. Zero to One author.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Contrarian thinker. Responds to unique, bold visions. Hates competition, loves monopolies.

decisionMakers.name: Keith Rabois
decisionMakers.title: General Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Executive at PayPal, LinkedIn, Square, Opendoor. Known as one of the best operators in Silicon Valley.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Operator at heart. Very direct feedback. Loves founders who ship fast and obsess over metrics.

decisionMakers.name: Trae Stephens
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Co-founder of Anduril Industries. Leads defense and hard tech investments.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Defense tech champion. Very mission-driven. Best approached with national security angle.

firms.name: Khosla Ventures
firms.thesis: We invest in science and technology that matters. We back entrepreneurs solving large, important problems with breakthrough technologies in AI, climate, biology, and space.

decisionMakers.name: Vinod Khosla
decisionMakers.title: Founder
decisionMakers.bio: Co-founded Sun Microsystems. Led investments in Impossible Foods, OpenAI, Commonwealth Fusion.
decisionMakers.education: CMU, MS; IIT Delhi, BTech; Stanford, MBA
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Visionary who thinks in decades. Loves moonshots. Responds to world-changing ambition.

decisionMakers.name: Sven Strohband
decisionMakers.title: Managing Director
decisionMakers.bio: Leads robotics and AI investments. Led OpenAI's first funding round.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Robotics and AI researcher. Deeply technical. Great at evaluating hard tech.

decisionMakers.name: Kanu Gulati
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Leads enterprise AI investments. Former product lead at Google.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Product-led investor. Focuses on AI applied to enterprise workflows.

firms.name: General Catalyst
firms.thesis: We invest in powerful, positive change that endures. We partner with founders from seed to growth, bringing the full weight of our network and platform to help them build iconic companies.

decisionMakers.name: Hemant Taneja
decisionMakers.title: CEO & Managing Director
decisionMakers.bio: CEO of General Catalyst. Author of Unscaled. Led investments in Stripe, Snap, Airbnb.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Systems thinker. Very strategic. Loves founders who think about ecosystem-level change.

decisionMakers.name: Katie Stanton
decisionMakers.title: Managing Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Former VP Global Media at Twitter. Leads health assurance initiatives.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Mission-driven. Passionate about healthcare transformation. Great network in DC and healthcare.

decisionMakers.name: Quentin Clark
decisionMakers.title: Managing Director
decisionMakers.bio: Former CTO at SAP. Leads enterprise AI investments.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Enterprise tech veteran. Very practical. Great for B2B founders seeking enterprise GTM advice.

firms.name: Insight Venture Partners
firms.thesis: We are the leading global scale-up investor. We partner with high-growth technology companies, providing the capital, operational expertise, and strategic guidance needed to scale from $10M to $1B+ ARR.

decisionMakers.name: Jeff Horing
decisionMakers.title: Co-Founder & Managing Director
decisionMakers.bio: Co-founded Insight in 1995. Led investments in Shopify, Twitter, Alibaba.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Growth equity pioneer. Very focused on unit economics and path to profitability.

decisionMakers.name: Deven Parekh
decisionMakers.title: Managing Director
decisionMakers.bio: Board member at Twitter and Alibaba. Focus on fintech and marketplace investments.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Global perspective. Excellent for international expansion strategy. Very analytical.

decisionMakers.name: Rachel Geller
decisionMakers.title: Principal
decisionMakers.bio: Leads Series A and B investments in AI infrastructure.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: AI infrastructure expert. Very technical background. Loves MLOps and developer tools.

firms.name: First Round Capital
firms.thesis: We're built to serve founders at the earliest stage. We wrote the first checks into Uber, Square, and Roblox. We provide unmatched community, platform, and founder support from day one.

decisionMakers.name: Josh Kopelman
decisionMakers.title: Founder & Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Founded Half.com (acquired by eBay), TurnTide. Led investments in Uber, LinkedIn, Square.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Speed demon. Known for making decisions in days. Loves scrappy founders with unique insights.

decisionMakers.name: Hayley Barna
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Co-founder of Birchbox. Leads consumer and marketplace investments.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Consumer product expert. Great eye for brand and distribution. Very supportive founder coach.

decisionMakers.name: Teddy Citrin
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Leads AI and developer tool investments. Former founder.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Developer tools and AI-native companies. Very responsive. Loves product-led growth stories.

firms.name: Bessemer Venture Partners
firms.thesis: We partner with entrepreneurs to build enduring businesses. With 110+ years of history, we've invested in 145+ IPOs. We invest from seed to growth across cloud, consumer, healthcare, and deep tech.

decisionMakers.name: Byron Deeter
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Created Bessemer's cloud investing practice. Led investments in Twilio, Shopify, ServiceTitan.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Cloud/SaaS legend. Created the 10 Laws of Cloud. Loves unit economics and net retention.

decisionMakers.name: Elliott Robinson
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Leads growth investments. Board member at LinkedIn.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Growth-stage expert. Focuses on expansion revenue and international growth.

decisionMakers.name: Mary D'Onofrio
decisionMakers.title: Partner
decisionMakers.bio: Created BVP's Atlas platform for cloud benchmarking. Expert in cloud metrics.
decisionMakers.personalityNotes: Data-obsessed. Created the Centaur ($100M ARR) milestone concept. Always benchmarking metrics.
